study_scope.note: Post-2023 work is prioritized for design and collision analysis; older work is retained only as methodological background.

reset.evidence: Ten non-confirmatory clean reset/workflow/oracle cycles passed on 2026-08-16; local artifact is gitignored.

tasks.intent: Create a page in a designated shelf, save it, and verify that the title and body persist after navigation away and back.

oracle.assertion: Independent database/API query confirms the page belongs to the designated shelf and contains the expected title/body hash.

phase2_evidence.functional_fault: persistence-mismatch was detected by the Playwright visible-state assertion and the independent database oracle
phase2_evidence.ui_evolution: bookstack-layout-v1 preserved the workflow and persisted-state oracle in one smoke run
phase2_evidence.three_arm_pilot: latest 1 repetition: Playwright and hybrid passed; pure visual failed on provider tool-call JSON after oracle state was reached; an earlier rerun passed 3/3

tasks.intent: Starting from the authenticated home page, open Books, open the book named Book, and finish only when that book's page is visibly open.

oracle.assertion: A post-run evaluator confirms the browser is on the exact /books/<slug> overview route (not a chapter/page descendant) and an exact Book heading is visible; it does not use the agent verdict or action history.

phase2_evidence.evolution_pilot: 1 repetition x 3 arms passed under bookstack-layout-v1
phase2_evidence.status: non-confirmatory; repetition and power remain unfrozen

reset.evidence: Three clean-volume start/reset cycles reached the hostname-sensitive HTTP 200 gate and restored exactly 18 seeded events; the latest automated cycle took 33.841 seconds.

tasks.intent: Create an event with a fixed title and date, publish it, and verify the public event page and stored metadata.

oracle.assertion: Independent database/API query confirms the event title/date/status and the public page exposes the same values.

phase2_evidence.task_run: accessibility-first Playwright create-event workflow passed after a clean Indico reset
phase2_evidence.oracle: independent PostgreSQL query matched exactly one public lecture event on the requested date

reset.evidence: Two ephemeral-container start/reset cycles returned HTTP 200 and the same three-item fixed API probe; the cached-image reset took 2.241 seconds.

tasks.intent: Search the product catalog for a fixed query and verify the returned products and visible result list.

oracle.assertion: An independent evaluator checks both the visible browser post-condition (search route/query, textbox value, expected visible result cards, and absent negative control) and a REST query returning the fixed product identifiers/names; neither reads the agent verdict or action history.

phase2_evidence.task_run: accessibility-first Playwright search passed after deterministic container startup
phase2_evidence.oracle: independent REST query matched the three fixed product names for q=apple; visible UI post-condition evaluator is implemented for agent runs
